QuestInfo.name: Professor Foxwit's New Research Results
QuestInfo.0: Professor Foxwit, who has been working diligently at a high place in NLC, will be presenting the results of his new research. Talk to Professor Foxwit.\n
QuestInfo.1: According to Professor Foxwit's research on Iruvata, the speediest monster in Neo City, the secret to the monster's speed is in its equipped android gears.\n
QuestInfo.2: Professor Foxwit explained the new suit and referred you to T-1337, who isn't too far from your current location.\n

0.0: I became interested in a region called Neo City and began my research about the monsters who reside there. It didn't take long before I noticed a peculiar monster called Iruvata.
0.1: As I labored in my studies regarding Iruvata, I discovered something almost unbelievable. Are you curious?

yes.0: Yes, what I witnessed through my thick lens made me think twice. It was Iruvata, a monster whose speed was incredibly fast. My burgeoning interest in the creature led me to conduct in-depth research.
yes.1: How is Iruvata capable of such speed? That was the question I sought to answer. I would spend countless long nights researching until one night, when I finally discovered something amazing... The speed and strength of Iruvata are derived from its android gears!
yes.2: I don't know which programmer invented it, but it was really something else! I didn't stop there, though. I continued my research to determine whether anyone can move as fast as an android, only to realize that...
yes.3: I had discovered a way to build a memory chip that can replicate the android gear! And I'm not going to stop now. I'm thinking about conducting more research.
yes.4: If you want to make android gears, you should talk to T-1337, who isn't too far from here. I'll email him and let him know that you'll be coming to see him.

no.0: If you are interested in the results of my unique research, come talk to me again.
